acquisition_method.evidence: The mass spectrometer was operated in data-dependent mode in which an initial FT scan recorded the mass range of m/z 350–1500.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Sequencing grade modified trypsin was purchased from Promega (Madison, WI, USA).

collision_energy.evidence: The top 20 most intense masses were selected for higher-energy collision dissociation (HCD) with an isolation window of 1.5 m/z and a normalized collision energy of 30 eV.

fragmentation_method.evidence: The top 20 most intense masses were selected for higher-energy collision dissociation (HCD) with an isolation window of 1.5 m/z and a normalized collision energy of 30 eV.

ionization_type.evidence: The peptides were eluted using a 5–40% B gradient (0.1% formic acid in acetonitrile) over 90 min into a nano-electrospray ionization (nESI) Q Exactive mass spectrometer (ThermoFisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA).

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: The peptides were eluted using a 5–40% B gradient (0.1% formic acid in acetonitrile) over 90 min into a nano-electrospray ionization (nESI) Q Exactive mass spectrometer (ThermoFisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA).

ptm.evidence: static modifications of carbamidomethylation for all cysteine residues
flexible modification of oxidation modifications for methionine residues
